title: Explainer-What are credit default swaps and why are they spooking AI investors?
title_zh: 解释者-什么是信用违约掉期以及为什么它们会吓到人工智能投资者？
summary: By Amanda Cooper July 29 (Reuters) - Shares in companies driving the AI boom have been under pressure for weeks.
summary_zh: 作者：阿曼达·库珀 (Amanda Cooper) 7 月 29 日（路透社）——推动人工智能繁荣的公司的股价几周来一直面临压力。

title: Apple set for strongest June-quarter sales growth in 5 years
title_zh: 苹果 6 月份季度销售增长将创 5 年来最强劲
summary: Apple's decision to hold iPhone prices steady is set to power its strongest June-quarter sales growth in five years, but investors will want to know how long it can resist an increase.
summary_zh: 苹果决定保持 iPhone 价格稳定，这将推动 6 月份季度销售增长五年来最强劲，但投资者想知道它能抵制涨价多久。

title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with aiding terrorism, he gives Moscow the finger
title_zh: 俄罗斯指控 Telegram 创始人杜罗夫协助恐怖主义，他指责莫斯科
summary: MOSCOW, July 29 () - Russia said on Wednesday it had charged Telegram founder Pavel Durov with facilitating terrorist activity, alleging that his hugely popular messaging app was being used by Ukrainian spies to organise attacks inside Russia.
summary_zh: 莫斯科，7 月 29 日 - 俄罗斯周三表示，已指控 Telegram 创始人帕维尔·杜罗夫 (Pavel Durov) 协助恐怖活动，指控乌克兰间谍利用他广受欢迎的消息应用程序在俄罗斯境内组织袭击。

title: UK regulator investigates whether Microsoft misled personal and family customers
title_zh: 英国监管机构调查微软是否误导个人和家庭客户
summary: Britain's antitrust regulator said it would investigate Microsoft over whether it ‌misled personal and family customers when marketing ‌subscription plans for its ever-popular Microsoft 365 product, resulting in ​them overpaying.
summary_zh: 英国反垄断监管机构表示，将调查微软在为其广受欢迎的 Microsoft 365 产品推销订阅计划时是否误导个人和家庭客户，导致他们支付过高费用。

title: Magnificent 7 results set to test broadening US stock market
title_zh: 七大业绩将考验美国股市的扩大
summary: By Lewis Krauskopf NEW YORK, July 29 (Reuters) - The S&P 500 has struggled to make further headway since its early June record peak, but that tepid performance belies churning beneath the market's
summary_zh: 作者：Lewis Krauskopf 纽约，7 月 29 日（路透社）——自 6 月初创下历史新高以来，标准普尔 500 指数一直在努力取得进一步进展，但这种不温不火的表现掩盖了市场底层的动荡。

title: Microsoft set for $190 billion market value swing after earnings results, options indicate
title_zh: 期权显示，微软在财报公布后市值将波动 1900 亿美元
summary: Options traders expect a roughly $190 billion swing in Microsoft's market value after it reports earnings on Wednesday, an unusually large move that underscores investors' growing eagerness to see if billions of dollars in ‌AI spending are beginning to pay off.
summary_zh: 期权交易员预计，在微软周三公布财报后，其市值将出现约 1900 亿美元的波动，这是一个异常大的波动，突显出投资者越来越渴望看到数十亿美元的人工智能支出是否开始获得回报。

title: S&P 8,500 melt-up? Why money is leaving big tech
title_zh: 标准普尔 8,500 指数熔涨？为什么资金正在离开大型科技公司
summary: Trader Talk host Kenny Polcari, Robinhood CIO Stephanie Guild, and Payne Capital Management President Ryan Payne break down the market's massive rotation out of big tech, the reality of AI infrastructure spending, and the bold case for an S&P 8,500 melt-up by year-end.
summary_zh: Trader Talk 主持人 Kenny Polcari、Robinhood 首席信息官 Stephanie Guild 和 Payne Capital Management 总裁 Ryan Payne 详细分析了市场对大型科技公司的大规模轮换、人工智能基础设施支出的现实...

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures steady in countdown to Fed decision, AI earnings test
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在美联储决定倒计时、人工智能盈利测试中保持稳定
summary: Investors braced for a Fed decision, a flood of earnings, and a potential reescalation in the war with Iran.
summary_zh: 投资者准备迎接美联储的决定、大量财报以及与伊朗的战争可能重新升级。

title: Asian stock rout deepens as AI worries grip markets
title_zh: 由于人工智能担忧影响市场，亚洲股市暴跌加剧
summary: By Ankur Banerjee SINGAPORE, July 29 (Reuters) - Asian stocks sank on Wednesday, extending a vicious selloff as anxiety about AI valuations and whether the massive spending will deliver returns
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 7 月 29 日 - 亚洲股市周三下跌，由于对人工智能估值以及大规模支出能否带来回报的担忧，导致恶性抛售延续。
